bulbasaur.heading: Keep Grass attacks connecting
bulbasaur.intro: Bulbasaur turns Grass hits into small heals through Synthesis, with regeneration and stronger healing behind it. Keep attacks connecting while you move around the edge of the crowd. Standing still to land another hit is a poor trade if it closes your exit.
bulbasaur.play: Keep Vine Whip working while Razor Leaf levels up. Solar Beam is offered later, so Flower Beam is a direction for the build rather than damage you can count on in the opening.
bulbasaur.caution: Grass-hit healing is capped at five triggers per second. More projectiles can help coverage but do not provide unlimited sustain.

seo.title: Bulbasaur - PokeBonk: How to Get & Build Guide
seo.description: PokeBonk how to get Bulbasaur: check the starting partner, unlock challenge and evolution levels, then compare attacks, Ultimates and builds for your run.

obtain.intro: There are two routes to Bulbasaur: choose it as your first partner on a fresh session, or complete its League challenge and capture its normal encounter later. The first route gives you the partner immediately; the second has an extra capture step.

steps.title: Choose Bulbasaur as your first partner, or check your League
steps.text: On a fresh session, select Bulbasaur from the three first-partner choices. That choice makes Bulbasaur your first League member. If you already chose a different starter, continue with the partner you own; you do not need to erase your progress or start a new account.

steps.title: If you chose another starter, finish two runs
steps.text: Bulbasaur’s League challenge is to complete 2 runs, win or lose. A clear is not required. Check the challenge in the League after those attempts: completing it makes the partner available for the encounter-and-capture step, rather than immediately adding it to your selectable roster.

steps.title: Weaken the normal Bulbasaur encounter and capture it
steps.text: If Bulbasaur was not your initial partner, find its challenge encounter in the following run. Defeat or weaken it until the game marks it ready for capture, then move close and use the capture input shown on screen to throw your Poké Ball. Do not leave the encounter or take the exit while it is still waiting to be caught. Completing the challenge and defeating the encounter are separate from actually capturing it.

steps.title: Confirm Bulbasaur has joined your League
steps.text: Check the League after the capture and select Bulbasaur when you start the run you want to play. A Pokédex sighting only records that you have seen a species. A shiny catch unlocks a look but does not substitute for the normal challenge-and-capture requirement; a captured Alpha fights beside you for that run and does not join your League.

obtain.after: Once Bulbasaur belongs to your League, you can choose it at the beginning of later runs. You do not have to repeat its unlock challenge for every attempt. Its later forms are reached by leveling during a run, so unlocking the family’s starting partner and evolving it are two different goals.

faq.question: How do you get Bulbasaur in PokeBonk?
faq.answer: Choose Bulbasaur from the first-partner screen on a fresh session. If you chose another starter, complete 2 runs, win or lose, then weaken and capture the normal Bulbasaur encounter after its League challenge is complete.

faq.question: What level does Bulbasaur evolve in PokeBonk?
faq.answer: Bulbasaur evolves into Ivysaur at run level 24 in the reviewed v0.8.62 data. The same run later reaches Venusaur at level 41. Use the displayed run level, not an individual attack’s level or the evolution threshold from another Pokémon game.

faq.question: Is Bulbasaur a good first partner in PokeBonk?
faq.answer: It is a sensible learning pick if your Grass attacks keep landing. Synthesis provides regeneration, stronger healing and healing on Grass hits. It is less forgiving when you stop connecting attacks, and the Grass-hit healing is capped at five triggers per second.

faq.question: What is Bulbasaur’s signature fusion recipe?
faq.answer: Flower Beam combines Razor Leaf and Solar Beam. Both attacks must reach attack level 8 before using Bill’s Machine. The later ingredient still needs to appear as an offer and receive upgrades; reaching a run-level milestone does not finish it for you.

faq.question: Which vitamins should I use for Bulbasaur?
faq.answer: For a build centered on Flower Beam, Calcium supports its special damage. Super Potion helps with recovery between hits, while Iron is an alternative when contact damage is ending the run. These are build directions, not a requirement to fill all three base slots with one fixed combination.

faq.question: Does catching a shiny Bulbasaur unlock it as a starting partner?
faq.answer: A shiny catch unlocks the family’s shiny look but does not replace the normal League challenge and capture for Bulbasaur. If Bulbasaur is still locked, complete its League challenge and capture the normal partner. Seeing it in the Pokédex or recruiting an Alpha for one run is not the same unlock.

ivysaur.heading: Make the middle stage count
ivysaur.intro: Ivysaur arrives at run level 24 in a run started with Bulbasaur. The new form keeps the family kit and passive; this is not a separate League unlock or a fresh loadout.
ivysaur.play: Use the middle stage to finish the attacks you have already invested in. Check Razor Leaf and Solar Beam before committing to Flower Beam. Keep an escape lane while you gather upgrades for Venusaur.
ivysaur.caution: The larger species stats are not your final in-run HP or damage. Lab, passive effects and the upgrades you collected still change the result.

steps.title: Choose Squirtle as your first partner, or check your League
steps.text: On a fresh session, select Squirtle from the three first-partner choices. That choice makes Squirtle your first League member. If you already chose a different starter, continue with the partner you own; you do not need to erase your progress or start a new account.

steps.title: If you chose another starter, finish two runs

steps.title: Weaken the normal Squirtle encounter and capture it
steps.text: If Squirtle was not your initial partner, find its challenge encounter in the following run. Do not leave the encounter or take the exit while it is still waiting to be caught. Completing the challenge and defeating the encounter are separate from actually capturing it.

steps.title: Confirm Squirtle has joined your League
steps.text: Check the League after the capture and select Squirtle when you start the run you want to play. A Pokédex sighting only records that you have seen a species.
